original_title: You Can Now Buy GTA 6 Burgers And Fried Chicken IRL, But It’s Not Cheap
summary_en: Rockstar Games is bringing the iconic in-game eateries of Grand Theft Auto 6 to life with real-world Burger Shot and Cluckin' Bell locations. Fans can now taste a slice of Vice City, but it comes with a premium price tag.
ai_analysis: This marketing stunt cleverly bridges the gap between the virtual world of GTA 6 and the real-world anticipation, leveraging fan passion for an immersive, albeit expensive, taste of the upcoming game.

en.title: GTA 6 Burgers Hit Miami: Is $28.50 the Price of Vice City?
en.summary: Rockstar Games is bringing the iconic in-game eateries of Grand Theft Auto 6 to life with real-world Burger Shot and Cluckin' Bell locations. Fans can now taste a slice of Vice City, but it comes with a premium price tag.
en.body:
Rockstar Games is dialing up the hype for **Grand Theft Auto 6** in a way that’s both deliciously literal and undeniably pricey. As anticipation for the game's November 19, 2026 release continues to build, fans in Miami now have the unique opportunity to sample the culinary delights of **Burger Shot** and **Cluckin' Bell** – the fast-food chains familiar to anyone who’s spent time in the chaotic streets of Los Santos. These in-game parodies of real-world fast-food giants have materialized at Miami’s Kaseya Center, home of the NBA’s Heat games, transforming concession stands into immersive **GTA 6** experiences.

The Kaseya Center has embraced the **GTA 6** aesthetic, with staff sporting branded uniforms and the venues themselves echoing the game's vibrant Vice City setting. Beyond the food, elevator advertisements reference in-game elements like the radio station Vice City FM and the children's TV show Macca & Friends, further cementing the partnership. This elaborate marketing push also saw the iconic Vice City logo emblazoned atop the Kaseya Center itself, a bold statement ahead of the game's launch.

## A Taste of Vice City

For those eager to get a literal taste of **Grand Theft Auto 6**, the experience comes at a cost. The cheapest combo available at the **Burger Shot** stand, featuring a cheeseburger, fries, and a drink, is priced at $28.50 before tax. A step up to an applewood bacon burger combo will set you back $31. While steep, these prices are unfortunately not out of the ordinary for concessions at major sporting events. The **Cluckin' Bell** fried chicken offerings are expected to be similarly priced. For now, these **GTA 6**-themed eateries appear to be exclusive to the Kaseya Center, making it a must-visit for dedicated fans in the area.

## The Road to Vice City

The **GTA 6** marketing blitz is clearly in full swing, extending beyond just the Kaseya Center. The partnership is set to peak on November 18th, with an NBA Heat game featuring themed jerseys and a court inspired by the game's setting. This event precedes the game's release by just one day, a strategic move designed to maximize buzz. **Grand Theft Auto 6** is slated for release on November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. The standard edition will retail for $79.99, with the Ultimate Edition costing $99.99 in the US. Physical copies will include a digital download code, eschewing traditional discs. Details regarding a potential PC or Nintendo Switch 2 version have not yet been announced.

content_raw: Rockstar's marketing efforts for GTA 6 are ramping up, and this now includes burgers and fried chicken that you can buy in real life. Rockstar's partnership with Miami's Kaseya Center expanded this week with the introduction of the restaurants "Burger Shot" and "Cluckin' Bell" at Heat games. These are based on their in-game counterparts, which themselves are parodies of Burger King and KFC. According to people who were at the game, the Burger Shot burgers are not custom items that Rockstar created but instead are the same Skinny Louie burgers that the Kaseya Center previously offered, just wrapped in GTA 6 branding. The workers have Burger Shot shirts and hats, too, to help play things up further. What does a GTA 6 burger cost? The cheapest combo that people can buy includes a cheeseburger with fries and a drink for $28.50 before tax. This scales up to $31 for an applewood bacon burger combo. This is expensive, but it's not out of line with how much it costs to eat food at a sporting event today. The Kaseya Center also added a Cluckin' Bell restaurant that sells fried chicken. The prices for the food here are no doubt similarly expensive. For now, it appears Burger Shot and Cluckin' Bell's IRL locations will be limited to the Kaseya Center. Beyond the restaurant takeovers, the Kaseya Center now has advertisements on its elevators referencing in-game elements of GTA 6, including the radio station Vice City FM and the TV show Macca & Friends. Before this, Rockstar airlifted the Vice City logo onto the top of the Kaseya Center. The partnership continues in November with a big event at an NBA Heat game on November 18 where the team will wear themed jerseys and play on a court inspired by GTA 6. The game then releases the next day, November 19, for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
